description:
Canonical plan: docs/plans/2026-11-04-1314-refactor-jido-test-tree-plan.md

Objective
Contributors can find each Jido test, fixture, and proof by purpose and owning Jido.* namespace without understanding former package layouts. Each proof claim has one canonical owner.

Scope
Reorganize the complete test tree from integrated revision d620b31. Consolidate shared support and property evidence infrastructure. Consolidate load and benchmark trees under perf, and live and service trees under external. Remove only proven duplication. Update active path consumers atomically.

Technical direction
Keep test/jido/<namespace> for canonical behavior. Use flattened jido_<namespace> directories inside special proof lanes. Use one compiled test/support root, test/consumers for isolated projects, production Jido.* namespaces for executable tests, and Jido.Test.* for helpers. Make component_proof.yml the semantic ownership registry: one canonical owner per claim and a distinct reason for each supplemental proof. Add no layout guard or compatibility path.

Definition of done
All seven plan units are closed in dependency order. Required offline and quality gates pass. Covenant IDs and obligation counts remain stable. Every proof claim has one canonical owner, supplemental proof states distinct value, retired active paths and test-only namespaces are absent, and final duplication is below the recorded baseline.

Initial frontier
The upstream jido-nnq epic is closed and integrated at d620b31. U1 is ready.
title: Organize the Jido test tree
